about: 수령수표조회(E060603) [신규(F2)] 수령수표내역입력 줄의 [부서] · [프로젝트] — 코드도움으로 고르면 칸에 이름('개발팀' · '20210801A Project'), 저장 → 수령수표거래내역 [부서명] · [프로젝트명], 조회 조건 [부서]로 걸러짐. [일자-No.] 로 연 수정 창 끝 [H] → '이력' 창 머리 '[2026/10/14 -4]' · 신규 → 고쳐 저장 뒤 수정(2026-10-14 원본 실측). 발행수표조회 감소 줄 '지출결의서' 의 [회계전표일자-No.] 를 누르면 그 지출결의서(수정)로 간다.

shots.name: 수령수표내역입력 — 부서 · 프로젝트 → 저장 → 수정 → [H] 신규 · 수정

js:(async()=>{const as=(await window.__api('GET','/bank-cards/accounts')).body.filter((x)=>x.active);const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const no='QADPW'+Date.now();sessionStorage.setItem('dpW',no);const r=await window.__api('POST','/checks/direct',{type:'ISSUED',date:ymd,increase:true,partnerId:null,bankAccountId:as[0].id,lines:[{checkNo:no,amount:12000,remark:'QA회계2 링크'}]});const w=await window.__api('POST','/checks/withdraw-report',{date:ymd,bankAccountId:(as.find((x)=>Number(x.balance)>=1000000)||as[1]).id,description:null,lines:[{checkId:r.body[0].id,memo:'QA회계2 링크'}]});sessionStorage.setItem('dpWJ',w.body[0].settleJournalId);location.reload();return w.status})()

js:(async()=>{const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const v=(await window.__api('GET','/vouchers?type=EXPENSE_REPORT&from='+ymd+'&to='+ymd)).body.rows.find((x)=>x.lines.some((l)=>l.description==='QA회계2 링크'));await window.__api('DELETE','/vouchers/'+v.id);const cs=(await window.__api('GET','/checks')).body;const w=cs.find((x)=>x.checkNo===sessionStorage.getItem('dpW'));const r=cs.find((x)=>x.checkNo===sessionStorage.getItem('dpNo'));const del=await window.__api('POST','/checks/delete',{decreaseIds:[],increaseIds:[w.id,r.id]});const left=(await window.__api('GET','/checks')).body.filter((x)=>x.checkNo===sessionStorage.getItem('dpW')||x.checkNo===sessionStorage.getItem('dpNo')).length;sessionStorage.setItem('dpGone',String(del.status===200&&left===0));return true})()
